description: Nora owns the family's backyard and is organizing the planting of a memorial tree during the family reunion weekend. She must make the final call about the tree, its placement and protection, and the ceremony arrangements, with input from her brother Eli, cousin Samira, and aunt June.

shared_context.S1: The family wants to plant a living memorial in Nora's backyard during the reunion weekend of 2026-05-22 through 2026-05-24.
shared_context.S2: Nora is choosing the tree, its location and protection, and the ceremony arrangements.
shared_context.S3: The backyard has a northwest lawn, an east patio, and a house along the southern edge of the property.
shared_context.S4: The tree nursery can provide several kinds of hardy young trees, and a small plaque may be placed nearby.
shared_context.S5: At Sunday dinner, Nora goes around the table and asks each person what should shape the memorial plan before she settles it.

PF1.text: Eli has the family's handwritten note in which their late grandmother specifically asked for a serviceberry tree as her memorial tree; he has not shown the note to Nora or the others yet.

PF2.text: Samira received a written recommendation from arborist Lena Ortiz that the memorial tree should go in the northwest lawn at least 10 feet from the house and should have a root barrier installed; the recommendation has not reached the family yet.

PF3.text: June promised to lead the memorial ceremony, but she is available to do so only on 2026-05-23 at 15:00; she has not yet told Nora about that specific availability.

acceptance_conditions: The memorial tree must be a serviceberry.
The tree must be placed in the northwest lawn.
A root barrier must be required.
The ceremony must be scheduled for 2026-05-23 at 15:00.
A commitment to follow the arborist's placement and protection plan must exist.
A commitment for June to lead the ceremony must exist.
Eli's grandmother-note fact must be cited as justification after being revealed.

decisive_facts.why: The grandmother's note changes the tree choice from an arbitrary hardy tree to the exact species serviceberry and supplies the specific fact Nora must cite.
The arborist's recommendation changes the placement to the northwest lawn, sets the required root barrier, and creates the commitment to follow that site-and-protection plan.
June's exact availability changes the ceremony to 2026-05-23 at 15:00 and creates the commitment naming June as its leader.
